name: Oath of Vengeance
summary: Avengers who hunt down those guilty of grievous sins.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.short: Oath spells that are always prepared for free.
features.summary: You always have your oath spells prepared once you reach the listed paladin levels. They don't count against the number of spells you prepare.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Abjure Enemy
features.short: Frighten a creature and stop it from moving.
features.summary: As an action, choose a creature within 60 ft.: it makes a WIS save (fiends and undead at disadvantage) or is frightened for 1 minute with speed 0; on a success its speed is halved.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Vow of Enmity
features.short: Bonus action: advantage on attacks against one creature for a minute.
features.summary: As a bonus action, utter a vow against a creature within 10 ft.: you have advantage on attack rolls against it for 1 minute.

features.name: Relentless Avenger
features.short: Opportunity attack hits let you chase the target.
features.summary: When you hit a creature with an opportunity attack, you can move up to half your speed immediately after, without provoking opportunity attacks.

features.name: Soul of Vengeance
features.short: Reaction: attack your Vow of Enmity target when it attacks.
features.summary: When a creature under your Vow of Enmity makes an attack, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against it if it is within range.

features.name: Avenging Angel
features.short: Grow wings (60 ft. fly) and a frightening aura.
features.summary: As an action, for 1 hour you gain wings with a 60 ft. flying speed and emanate a 30 ft. aura of menace that can frighten enemies (WIS save); attacks against frightened creatures have advantage. Once per long rest.
